description: Read the workspace's site configuration: languages (default and enabled - the keys every i18n field takes), site name, enabled features, and the cart and commerce settings (currency, tax rates, shipping methods, custom order fields). Read-only, no arguments; returns found: false when the workspace has none yet. The workspace's plan and limits: get_workspace_info; the page tree: list_pages.
name: get_site_config
title: Get site config
